# LAMMPS input script for Mg melting simulation

# Initialization
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Read initial structure
read_data Mg.data

# Replicate the system 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Define compute for density
compute density all property/atom mass
compute density_avg all reduce sum c_density
variable volume equal vol
variable density_gcm3 equal (c_density_avg/6.022e23)/(v_volume*1.0e-24)

# Initial minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# Set timestep
timestep 0.001

# NVT equilibration
velocity all create 300.0 12345
fix nvt all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density v_density_gcm3
run 10000
unfix nvt

# NPT relaxation
fix npt1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 10000
unfix npt1

# NPT heating
fix npt2 all npt temp 300.0 2000.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 20000
unfix npt2

# LAMMPS input script for Mg melting simulation

# Initialize simulation
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read initial structure
read_data mg.data

# Create 5x5x5 supercell
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Define compute for density
compute density all property/atom mass
compute mass_sum all reduce sum c_density
variable volume equal vol
variable density equal "c_mass_sum/(v_volume*10)"  # Convert to g/cm³

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-4 1.0e-6 100 1000

# Initialize velocities
velocity all create 300.0 4928459 dist gaussian

# NVT equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press density
dump 1 all custom 1000 nvt.lammpstrj id type x y z vx vy vz
run 10000
undump 1
unfix 1

# NPT relaxation
fix 2 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
dump 2 all custom 1000 npt_relax.lammpstrj id type x y z vx vy vz
run 10000
undump 2
unfix 2

# NPT heating
fix 3 all npt temp 300.0 2000.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
dump 3 all custom 1000 npt_heat.lammpstrj id type x y z vx vy vz
thermo 100
run 20000
undump 3

# Print final density
print "Final_density: ${density}"
